evidence: PutIncidentKv stores a value only after SwarmLookupTenantAccess notes the same tenant, and ReadIncidentKv returns it only for that tenant and epoch.
ApprovePublic stores a body only when the approver differs from the author and the body is public, and ReusePublic reaches another case only for that record.
MeasureCache copies the cache bytes and reports that length, and CompleteCheckpoint restores an exact DtCkpt closure while a moment-free save stays partial.
OpenIncident pins one generation, and SwapGeneration of a different generation leaves that pin in place until CloseIncident.
Place is refused until RestrictPlacement records location and processor, and a mismatched processor is refused.
PoisonCache calls SwarmNoteNotNoPoison and withdraws use, and FailRuntimeQualification withdraws use the same way.
IssueLearningRelease returns UNQUALIFIED. release_qualified stays false. No learning release is issued.
AssignHoldout keeps time, campaign, tenant, and lineage partitions apart, and the same lineage key cannot enter a second partition.
PreserveCase keeps provenance and license for synthetic and public cases, calls SwarmGenerationEngine::Eligible, and refuses a private kind.
JointDecision accepts a candidate only when utility and benign-case harm both pass, and qualified stays false.
TrainCompeting runs IntegerTrainer from a parent into two different descendants, and EvaluateDescendant refuses the author and accepts a different evaluator.
SecondResearchCycle calls SwarmGenerationEngine::Continue, which stays unqualified, and no second research cycle is executed.
FundPool uses SwarmDefBudget so readiness, incident, and improvement balances stay separate when one pool pays a milestone.
FundPool of one outpoint on a second pool returns OUTPOINT and leaves the first pool's collateral in place.
ReconcileAtoms requires confirmed atoms to cover fees, settled atoms, earned unpaid atoms, and reserved new work, and refuses a negative remainder.
JoinPool records membership with NOT_PAID, and EarnWork records accepted work without paying membership alone.
AllocateMilestones uses floor division, largest-remainder order, and per-contract caps, and a zero weight sum leaves the pool unallocated.
SelfDeal refuses the payer, EarnWork refuses a repeated receipt, Milestone refuses a payout above the balance, and an urgent label does not raise the rate.
DisclosePayment reports SwarmPayReg mode REGTEST_UNBROADCAST, enforceable false, and oracle trust ORACLE_NOT_SETTLEMENT.
QualifyNativeFunding calls SwarmPayReg::Settle and leaves qualified and spendable false.
ProvePaymentPaths returns UNQUALIFIED. hosts stays 1. Unilateral exit, expiry, fee, stale state, and watchtower paths are not proven.
ReserveBacking funds one pool, NoteCredit returns NOT_BACKING without raising that balance, and RouteTerms stores route atoms apart from both.
PromiseEmergency succeeds only when the readiness balance already covers the tier, and a credit note does not cover it.
KeepClaim uses SwarmPayReg::Claim, FailCompute leaves the claim, and Reorganize drops only pending work.
